kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public create-baseline --baseline-name BaselineName --project-id 10000 --owner 1000000000001 --priority 13578 --overtime-settings Time=00:00 Cycle=1 --baseline-type DAILY --api-version 2020-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateBaseline

parameters.help_en: The DataWorks workspace ID. You can log on to the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) and go to the Workspace page to query the ID
parameters.help_zh: DataWorks工作空间的ID，您可以登录DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入工作空间管理页面查看ID
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account used by the baseline owner
parameters.name: owner

parameters.help_en: The priority of the baseline. Valid values: {1,3,5,7,8}
parameters.help_zh: 基线的优先级，取值范围为{1,3,5,7,8}
parameters.name: priority

parameters.help_en: The ancestor nodes of nodes in the baseline
parameters.name: node_ids

fields.help_en: The cycle that corresponds to the committed completion time. For a day-level baseline, set this parameter to 1. For an hour-level baseline, set this parameter to a value that is no more than 24
fields.help_zh: 承诺时间对应的周期，天基线需要配置为1，小时基线可以配置最多24个周期
fields.name: cycle

fields.help_en: The committed completion time in the hh:mm format. Valid values of hh: [0,47]. Valid values of mm: [0,59]
fields.help_zh: 承诺时间，hh:mm格式，hh的取值范围为[0,47]，mm的取值范围为[0,59]
fields.name: time

parameters.help_en: The settings of the committed completion time of the baseline
parameters.name: overtime_settings

parameters.help_en: The alert margin threshold of the baseline. Unit: minutes
parameters.help_zh: 基线预警余量，单位为分钟
parameters.name: alert_margin_threshold

parameters.help_en: The type of the baseline. Valid values: DAILY and HOURLY
parameters.help_zh: 基线类型，包括DAILY（天基线）和HOURLY（小时基线）
parameters.name: baseline_type

RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true
false
Success.description_zh:
调用是否成功。取值如下：
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
